notes.title: Patch 1.8.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Version 1.8.2[/h2]

- The game will now stay AWAKE when it lost the focus. So you can let it runs in the background while you do other things. This make sense for this kind of game.
- The game will still SLEEP if the window is MINIMIZE ( in the task bar ).
- Sandbox will be available if one sandbox save game already exist.

notes.title: Update 1.8.2 ( BETA Branch )
notes.notes:
Yes, a small update already. ːsteamhappyː
[h3]Version 1.8.2 [/h3]

[i]!!! To access this version, you need to set the BETA in steam.[/i]

- The game will now stay [b]AWAKE [/b] when it lost the focus. So you can let it [u]runs in the background[/u] while you do other things. This make sense for this kind of game.
- The game will still SLEEP if the window is [b]MINIMIZE [/b] [i]( in the task bar )[/i]. 
- Sandbox will be available if one sandbox save game already exist.
